qa_pairs.question: What torque should be applied to the fuel vapor venting tank to body connection on the E30?
What is the specified torque for the fuel vapor venting tank to body connection on the E39?
Which BMW model requires the highest torque for the fuel vapor venting tank to body connection?
qa_pairs.answer: The E30 requires the highest torque at 4.5 Nm (ft. lbs.)

qa_pairs.question: Which BMW model has the lowest torque specification for the fuel vapor venting tank to body connection?
qa_pairs.answer: The E24 has the lowest torque specification at 3 Nm (ft. lbs.)

qa_pairs.question: What section and subsection does this fuel vapor venting specification fall under?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 16-3 Fuel tank and fuel lines, subsection 16 13 Fuel Vapor Venting

qa_pairs.question: How much more torque is required for the E30 compared to the E24 fuel vapor venting connection?
qa_pairs.answer: 1.5 Nm (ft. lbs.) more torque is required for the E30 compared to the E24

qa_pairs.question: Are there any screw specifications listed for the fuel vapor venting connections?
qa_pairs.answer: No, the screw column is empty for all fuel vapor venting connections shown
